items.statement: Payment received within 15 days for last three dispatches; full business cycle completed in 85 days vs 105 days disclosed in prospectus
items.quote: I would say, last three dispatches that we did, production we did and the dispatches we did and the payments we received, the entire cycle got completed in 85 days.

items.statement: Working capital requirement estimated at INR200-odd crores to support 40 propulsion systems per month or INR1,000 crore turnover
items.quote: So when you calculate by this, so if you need to achieve a turnover of, say, about 40 propulsion systems per m onth, or tentative INR1,000 crores, you need a working capital of about INR200-odd crores to cater to that maximum

items.statement: Inventory build-up in Q1 was temporary and driven by customer planning; it can fluctuate quarter-on-quarter.
items.quote: Broadly, it was temporary. Sometimes inventory builds up at the quarter-cnding when the OEMs require the material in the next quarter or something based on their planning. Some quarters it can be low, some quarters it can be high depending on the customers that we hold the inventory

items.statement: IPO proceeds of Rs. 220 crores earmarked for working capital will be used for scrap buying from new global sources and higher export credit.
items.quote: In this whole year, we expect it to kind of get utilized, mostly in terms of scrap buying from various new sources that we are trying to develop in various parts of the world. So, it will mostly cater to that. Also, certain export origins we are trying to develop, which would require higher eredit, and higher debt that would increase the debtors a little bit

items.statement: Working capital days currently around 95 days; sustainable target is 90-100 days with gross working capital requirement of Rs. 400 crores plus for FY27.
items.quote: As on date, our working capital is around 110 days. But currently, as the inventory has reduced somewhat due to purchases, as of today, our working capital is around 95 days. So, approximately, it will remain around this level. The gross working capital requirement that we are targeting for FY26- 27 will be around Rs. 400 crores plus.

items.statement: Long-term debt of Rs. 20 crores created on August 14; working capital limit utilization near zero; Rs. 150 crores in FDRs from IPO proceeds.
items.quote: We had two types of debt, long-term and short-term. Long-term, that was around Rs. 20 crores, which have been created on 14th August and working capital limit utilization is also almost zero due to IPO proceeds. Okay. Is there any cash on the books? Yes. We have around Rs. 150 crores FDR in the books as entry and use of IPO funds

items.statement: DSO reduced from 131 days to 119 days in Q1; expects to reduce DSO by 10-15 days each quarter and be up-to-date with working capital cycle in 2-3 quarters
items.quote: Our DSO basically has reduced from 131 days to 119 days. I'm not saying that it is great as far as LEAP is concerned. TARON is continuing to do well at 62, 63 days. We believe that every quarter we will be able to reduce 10 to 15 days into our DSO. In next two to three quarters, we will be up-to-date with our working capital cycle.

items.statement: Promoter Ashok Soota will sell 22.1% of his 44.2% stake in two tranches for INR 1,330 crores; post-merger he will hold 7.55% and will not be a promoter
items.quote: In the current transaction, Mr. Soota will divest 22.1% of his total holding of 44.2% holding in the C ompany in two tranches for an aggregate cash consideration of approximately INR 1,330

items.statement: Post-merger ITC Limited will hold 73.4% of combined entity; public shareholders including Mr. Soota will hold 26.6% with Soota as largest individual shareholder at 7.55%
items.quote: On consummation of the merger, ITC Limited will hold 73.4% of the combined entity and the public shareholders, including Mr. Soota, will hold the remaining 26.6%. Mr. Soota, with a 7.55% holding in the combined entity, will be the largest individual shareholder.

items.statement: ITC Infotech has related party transactions with ITC and affiliates including hotels; disclosed in filed financials
items.quote: ITC is not a not a very significant portion. It's yes, the hotels and there's a little bit of related party transaction. If you check on their filed financials, they have given a proper disclosure for that, Sushovan.

items.statement: ITC will subscribe to a rights issue in ITC Infotech to fund the purchase of promoter shares; no valuation implication as considered in swap ratios
items.quote: Yes, because the shares are going to be purchased by ITC Infotech, so they'll need the money. So ITC will be putting they are the 100% shareholders of ITC Infotech, so they'll be subscribing to a rights issue capitalizing Infotech, which will then make thi s transaction with Soota

items.statement: Zenrock Chemicals emerged as new promoter in January 2023; shares pledged for acquisition financing
items.quote: In the fourth quarter of 2026, a new leadership team comprising of very experienced industry professionals, including our chief commercial officer, our chief financial officer, myself, we took charge of the company's operations.

items.statement: No specific timeline for unpledging shares pledged for Kronox acquisition financing
items.quote: At this point, I don't have any updates with regards to the timeline of unpledging the shares that we have pledged as part of this acquisition.

items.statement: Kronox purchased Boric acid from Indo Borax in the past; arm's length pricing for future inter-company transactions
items.quote: Kronox has purchased buying Boric acid from us in the past, etc.. These are very easily visible synergies.

items.statement: Three Kronox promoters to continue with consultancy contracts for considerable period; retain 9.95% equity
items.quote: the three promoters will continue with us with a considerable period of time as a contract we have with them, which you already have seen. Also, they will continue to hold about 9.95% equity in the company

items.statement: Indo Borax internal accruals of Rs. 134-135 crores from sale of investments, FDs and cash for Kronox acquisition
items.quote: approximately Rs 134 - 135 Crores will come from internal accruals through the company itself, which is coming through sale of investments and FDs and other cash available with the company.

items.statement: Sale of two Mumbai commercial office spaces expected to fetch Rs. 48 crores for acquisition funding
items.quote: we are currently in the process of selling two non-core assets that we have in terms of commercial office spaces that we have in the city of Mumbai for a total consideration of about Rs 48 Crore

items.statement: No fresh equity issuance planned; acquisition funded via internal accruals, asset sales, term loan and promoter commitment
items.quote: we are funding it through, & we are working with lenders right now for a term loan, which will come through in the next couple of weeks. That term loan will be, which will fund the open offer amount and the gap between how much we have to, between the gap right now of what we have to pay the promoters as well.

items.statement: Promoter holding post-IPO is 70.84%
items.quote: Promoter holding post-issue is 70.84%.

items.statement: Cash and bank balances were INR52 crores as of June 30th before IPO proceeds
items.quote: Balance sheet at June 30th: net worth, INR325 crores; debt to equity, 0.03; INR52 crores cash.

items.statement: Net working capital absorbed around INR10 crores in the quarter due to inventory build-up
items.quote: So net working capital absorbed around INR10 crores in the quarter.

items.statement: IPO of INR301 crores at INR285 with INR93 crores fresh capital completed and listed on 19th August
items.quote: After the quarter closed, we completed our IPO. Issue of INR301 crores at INR285 listed on 19th August.

items.statement: Proposed acquisition of 80% stake in promoter entity AJC Jewel Manufacturers FZC, UAE via non-cash share swap valued up to Rs 9.6 crore
items.quote: The proposed transaction is valued at up to Rs. 9.6 crore and is structured entirely through a non-cash swap.

items.statement: Promoter family remuneration was 10-15% of PAT in FY26; management says will align with PAT going forward
items.quote: Going forward, we will align with PAT. As of now, | don't have any specific reason for this

items.statement: Operating cash flow has been negative for six years; management aims to turn positive in coming years but no exact timeline given
items.quote: in the coming years we will try... we will try to get that positive. Try to generate more cash. So now | can say the exact time when it will be

items.statement: Receivables growing faster than sales due to new corporate clients with longer credit periods; management working to reduce debtors
items.quote: We are trying to decrease that debtor means This is due to uh recently we added some uh corporate clients. Aditya: Okay. Ashraf: Uh they uh they have some more credit period than normal small and mid-sized customers. Anyway, we are uh we will try to decrease that

items.statement: Future equity fundraising possible to fund working capital for 100% capacity utilization
items.quote: So we will find through internal accrual, debt, and maybe through in future, maybe through in equity fundraising.

items.statement: 30% of INR500 crore capex already incurred; remaining to be funded from internal accruals over FY27-FY28
items.quote: Around 30% of overall funding requirem ents has already been incurred. We, therefore, see these announcements not as three isolated projects, but as part of IOL's broader journey of scale, diversification, backward integration, and deeper customer

items.statement: Capex of INR500 crore to be met through internal accruals over FY27 and FY28 with clear visibility of cash generation
items.quote: The capex to be incurred across the period of 2 years, that is financial year '27 and financial year '28. As you say and we already disclosed that 30% of capex is already been done. And the remaining for remaining capex, we have clear visibility of cash generation through operations, and we will met from internal accrual.

items.statement: Investments funded entirely through internal accruals reflecting confidence in cash generation capabilities
items.quote: Importantly, these investments are backed by identified market opportunities and are being funded through entirely internal accruals, reflecting our confidence in company's cash generation capabilities and long-term growth prospects.

items.statement: Previous auditor maxed out; appointing Price Waterhouse as statutory auditors
items.quote: our previous auditor maxed out, and we'll be appointing PW, Price Waterhouse, as the statutory auditors for the company going forward

items.statement: Promoters increased stake by 1% and can infuse 100% capital if needed
items.quote: Now promoters have increased the stake by 1%. With this, we are firm with our transparency and commitment.

items.statement: Promoters have given personal guarantees to majority of bank lenders
items.quote: Our promoters have given personal guarantee to the majority of bank lenders.

items.statement: No senior management resignations in last 3-4 months, leadership team stable
items.quote: In the last 3-4 months, no member of our senior management team has resigned. Our leadership team is completely with us, stable and committed.

items.statement: Zero promoter-related loan accounts, never been in practice
items.quote: Zero. Not a single account. It has never been in our practice.

items.statement: Maintain 2-3 months repayment buffer, collections exceed obligations
items.quote: We have a buffer of 2-3 months of repayment. We do not need it. Our collections only match it.

items.statement: Liquidity position adequate till March, submitted to rating agency
items.quote: We have a liquidity position is okay till next March but we have submitted it till March.

items.statement: Board passed resolution to convert from HFC to NBFC for multiple products
items.quote: Our board has passed a resolution that the company wants to be converted from its registered housing finance company to its non-banking finance company.

items.statement: IPO fresh issue of INR95 crores, INR55 crores used to repay borrowings against total borrowings of INR78 crores at March 2026; acquired land for INR25 crores for cable expansion from internal accruals
items.value: INR55 crores repaid; INR25 crores land acquisition
items.quote: Our IPO included a fresh issue of INR95 crores, of which INR55 crores has already been used to repay borrowings, against total borrowings of INR78 crores at March 2026. The lower finance cost should be visible from the coming quarter. During the Q1, we also acquired land for about INR25 crores for the expansion of our specialized cable

items.statement: EOW matter is sub judice in final stages; management sees no financial impact and has given all necessary representations
items.quote: So, the matter is still sub judice and under investigation in its final stages. And currently, as we see it, we don't see any possible impact on us financially on this case.

items.statement: IPO fresh issue raised INR60 crores; proceeds used for capex, debt repayment, and general corporate purposes
items.quote: Following our IPO, the as sir said, company has raised INR135.7 crores, including INR60 crores through the fresh issue. The fresh issue proceeds are being utilized towards the identified objectives, including the capital expenditure, repayment of our borrowings, and general corporate purpose.

items.statement: IPO fresh issue of INR60 crores completed; total IPO size INR135.7 crores including offer for sale
items.quote: Following our IPO, the as sir said, company has raised INR135.7 crores, including INR60 crores through the fresh issue.
